title: Cool Graphs: Active Property Search Towards Quantum Nano-Refrigerators (code)
description: Code for the NeurIPS 2026 paper "Cool Graphs: Active Property Search Towards Quantum Nano-Refrigerators": the Born-Markov master-equation oracle, the graph variational autoencoder, the active-learning loop and the random and GP-BO baselines.
